career_ladder.note: SSC Selection Posts recruit specialized, technical, and isolated posts across Central Government Ministries, attached/subordinate offices, and autonomous statutory commissions. The posts are classified under three educational tiers (Matriculation, Higher Secondary, and Graduation & Above). Career ladders follow the recruitment rules of the user Ministry/Department, advancing from technical assistants to supervisory and directorship roles.

exam_scheme.note: SSC conducts three separate Computer-Based Examinations (CBE) consisting of objective Multiple Choice Questions for posts with minimum educational qualification of Matriculation, Higher Secondary (10+2), and Graduation & Above levels. Candidates who apply for multiple levels appear once for each applicable examination level. Selection involves the Computer Based Examination followed by Skill Tests (Typing/CPT/Data Entry where prescribed) and Scrutiny of physical documents by regional SSC offices.

financial_package.note: Posts recruited under SSC Selection Posts span Pay Level 1 (₹18,000) to Pay Level 7 (₹44,900) under the 7th CPC. The modal technical representative post is Level 4 (₹25,500 – ₹81,100), with salary packages computed under central civilian rules.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on modal Level 4 entry basic pay of ₹25,500 with 58% DA (₹14,790), HRA (10% to 30% depending on posting station city tier), Transport Allowance (₹900 to ₹1,350 + DA on TA), and 10% NPS deduction.
